usage: AI-edited portrait for the about section. The original photo is preserved. The user selected the portrait and requested a Bambu Lab shipping box in place of the generated printer. The final version includes the requested subtle body-silhouette adjustment.
prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: professional environmental portrait for the 'Prazer, QRLabs 3D' about section of a small 3D-printing atelier website. Input image: edit target and sole identity reference. Transform this casual photo into a polished, natural studio portrait of EXACTLY THE SAME woman. Preserve her recognizable facial features, warm smile, skin tone, age, body proportions, shoulder-length dark hair, simple earrings and necklace, and plain white V-neck T-shirt. Do not beautify or reshape her face, smooth away natural skin texture, lighten skin, change age, or make a different person. Improve flattering soft window lighting, white balance and photographic sharpness. Replace the shipping carton and bare domestic background with a tidy modest maker's workbench and a softly out-of-focus small open-frame desktop 3D printer to her right, with one understated violet filament spool; credible small atelier, not a factory or luxury office. Pose remains relaxed and welcoming, facing camera, forearm naturally resting on the workbench, hands anatomically correct. Frame from the waist/chest up, landscape 4:3 composition, person centered slightly left, entire head visible with comfortable headroom and shoulders, composed to also work in a nearly square crop. Warm off-white background, subtle natural wood worktop, restrained violet/turquoise details. Editorial small-business portrait, realistic camera depth of field and natural tonal contrast, not cinematic, not an illustration. No visible logos, invented signage, labels, text, watermark or extra people.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the polished portrait that the user likes. Image 2 is a REFERENCE ONLY for the brown Bambu Lab shipping box and its logo. Change only the incorrect 3D printer in the right background of Image 1: remove the entire printer, its cables and the mounted purple filament reel, and put a clean brown corrugated-cardboard Bambu Lab shipping box in that same place on the rear workbench. Use the authentic small black Bambu Lab symbol and 'Bambu Lab' wordmark visible on the box in Image 2, facing camera. Box should feel like normal printer packaging in a small atelier, believable perspective and size, softly out of focus consistent with the background. No printer illustration or model-name text needed on the box, just the Bambu Lab logo. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE from Image 1: the exact woman's face and expression, identity, skin texture, hair, body, clothing, jewelry, hands, seated pose, framing, worktop, shelves, plants, foreground props, warm soft light, colors and photographic realism. Do not alter her face or redraw her identity, do not change the crop, do not add any people, no other changes. Opaque photographic image, same landscape aspect ratio.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this portrait with one subtle natural-looking body-proportion adjustment requested by the subject's website owner: make the woman's silhouette modestly slimmer through her upper arms and torso/waist. Keep realistic anatomy and natural clothing folds; no extreme slimming, no exaggerated hourglass shape, no warped workbench or background. Preserve her exact recognizable face, facial proportions, skin tone and texture, warm smile, hairstyle, age, jewelry, white V-neck T-shirt, hand details, seated pose and forearm placement. Keep the Bambu Lab cardboard box and its logo, all background shelves, plants, craft supplies, desk, lighting, colors, crop and image dimensions unchanged. Only adjust the body silhouette gently; do not change her identity or retouch her face. Maintain the natural professional photographic style and opaque background.
